Subject: Formal Warning Regarding Conduct at Office Party

Dear Janet,

I am writing to formally address your recent conduct at the office party. Your behavior, which included dancing on tables and shouting profanities, was both embarrassing and highly inappropriate. This type of conduct does not align with the professional standards we expect from our staff.

Please consider this a formal warning. We expect all employees to maintain professional decorum at all company events. Any further incidents of this nature will result in stricter disciplinary action.

We value your contributions to the team and hope to see an immediate improvement in your professional conduct.

Sincerely,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
